# ankra_credentials (Data Source)

Lists the organisation's credentials. The counterpart of `ankra credentials list` and `ankra credentials <provider> list`. The listing is metadata only and never carries a secret.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ankra_credentials" "hetzner" {
  credential_provider = "hetzner"
}

output "hetzner_credential_names" {
  value = data.ankra_credentials.hetzner.credentials[*].name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `credential_provider` (String) Only list credentials for this provider, such as `hetzner`, `ssh-key` or `aws`.

### Read-Only

- `credentials` (Attributes List) Credentials in the organisation. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--credentials))
- `id` (String) Placeholder identifier for the data source.

<a id="nestedatt--credentials"></a>
### Nested Schema for `credentials`

Read-Only:

- `auth_method` (String) AWS credentials only: `role` or `keys`.
- `available` (Boolean) Whether the platform considers the credential usable.
- `created_at` (String) When the credential was created.
- `credential_provider` (String) Provider the credential is for, such as `hetzner`, `ssh-key`, `aws` or `github`.
- `display_name` (String) Label shown instead of the name in the Ankra portal, when one was set.
- `fingerprint` (String) SSH key credentials only: the OpenSSH SHA256 fingerprint.
- `id` (String) Identifier of the credential.
- `managed` (Boolean) Ankra Cloud credentials only: whether it is the built-in credential the platform mints and renews.
- `name` (String) Credential name.
- `scope` (String) AWS credentials only: the onboarding scope (`cost`, `provisioning` or `self_managed`).
- `ssh_public_key` (String) SSH key credentials only: the stored public key.
- `state` (String) Lifecycle state the platform reports.
- `system` (Boolean) Whether the platform owns the credential.
- `updated_at` (String) When the credential was last changed.
